thread:
anya: FYI — seeing a small spike in partial WS frames on /v1/stream for hosted this morning. A few clients get a partial frame then the socket drops. Anyone already looking?

mike: I noticed a couple PD alerts. Where do you want people to check first (logs/traces/dash)?

anya: Start with the streaming dashboard and traces. Dash: https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/ws-streaming (prod). Traces: https://honeycomb.io/datasets/ws_traces/query ; raw socket logs live in S3 prefix: s3://redwood-logs/ws/stream/2026/03/17/

mike: can you paste the queries you use for partial-frame rate and chunk latency?

anya: sure — our quick checks:

Datadog metric for partial-frame rate (approx):
```
sum:ws.partial_frame_count{env:prod,route:/v1/stream} / sum:ws.connection_attempts{env:prod,route:/v1/stream}
```

Chunk latency rollups (p50/p95):
```
p50:ws.chunk_latency_ms{env:prod,route:/v1/stream}.rollup(p50)
p95:ws.chunk_latency_ms{env:prod,route:/v1/stream}.rollup(p95)
```

Honeycomb trace example to find partial frames:
```
dataset=ws_traces where event.partial_frame=true | group_by_trace
```

sam: I pushed a small tweak to kernel selection last night (reduce fallback churn). Could be related to framing if the new path changes batching. I can roll that back or run a canary.

jordan: If kernel selection is suspect, canary on a dedicated pool first. @sam can you tag the canary config and ping here?

sam: will do. diff: https://github.com/redwood/serving/commit/abcd123 — tagging the canary as serving/kernel-select-canary-20260317

ops-bot: Incident created: INC-4567 — partial-frame spike (prod /v1/stream). Priority: P2. Assigned: eng-runtime.

mike: quick ops request — our ws.partial_frame alert has been noisy. Proposal: raise threshold from 0.5% -> 1.5% and add a suppression clause when total connections < 100 for 5m. Also add a small grace window (2m) to avoid flapping. Thoughts?

anya: +1 to 1.5% and the low-volume suppress. Also update the alert runbook with the Honeycomb query above and a link to the canary tag.

mike: runbook snippet to paste: 
```
If alert fires: 1) check Datadog dashboard /ws-streaming for partial_frame_rate and chunk latency; 2) run Honeycomb query: dataset=ws_traces where event.partial_frame=true and duration>50ms | trace_id; 3) check recent deploys (gitops) and canary tags; 4) escalate to eng-runtime if >3% for 10m.
```

mike: @sam can you push the canary before 09:30 PT? I'll watch the dashboards and adjust alert noise if it stabilizes.

sam: canary tag pushed: serving/kernel-select-canary-20260317 — routing 5% of traffic to dedicated-canary pool now.

jordan: I'll schedule a quick async postmortem thread if it doesn't settle by EOD. Thanks for the quick coordination. :thumbsup:

anya: thanks — keeping an eye on the trace link and will post findings here if I see any request patterns (model, seq len, SDK version).
